name: pion
stack: Pion WebRTC (Go): its own ICE, DTLS, SCTP, SRTP and RTP stacks
version: github.com/pion/webrtc/v4 v4.2.29 (pion/ice v4.4.9, pion/dtls v3.1.16, pion/sctp v1.12.1, pion/srtp v3.1.3, pion/interceptor v0.1.51), built with Go 1.27.4

iceTcpActive.reason: Pion's ICE agent gathers TCP candidates only through a TCPMux, as passive ones: it has no active TCP candidate to reach a passive one
iceTcpActive.cite: pion/ice v4.4.9 gather.go gatherCandidatesLocal (case tcp: candidates from the TCPMux, tcpType = TCPTypePassive)

dtls13.reason: Pion's DTLS (pion/dtls v3) speaks DTLS 1.2 only
dtls13.cite: pion/webrtc v4.2.29 stats.go TransportStats.TLSVersion: "Value is always FEFD (DTLS 1.2)"; dtlstransport.go sets TLSVersion = "FEFD"

unbundled.reason: Pion runs one ICE and one DTLS transport per PeerConnection: in an answer it rejects (port 0) every section outside the offer's BUNDLE group, and with bundlePolicy max-compat it still runs every section over its one transport
unbundled.cite: pion/webrtc v4.2.29 sdp.go populateSDP (a section that does not bundleMatch gets MediaName.Port 0); peerconnection.go (one iceTransport / dtlsTransport per PeerConnection). Observed in train 10 round 1: Pion answered Rust's offer without a group with port 0 on both sections, and offered max-compat sections that it served on one transport

rollback.reason: Pion does not take a rollback description
rollback.cite: pion/webrtc v4.2.29 SetLocalDescription: "InvalidModificationError: invalid SDP type supplied to SetLocalDescription(): rollback" (train 10 round 1)

simulcastSend.reason: Pion writes no MID or RID header extension on the RTP it sends: its simulcast layers reach the receiver without a RID, so they cannot be told apart by RID (RFC 8853)
simulcastSend.cite: pion/webrtc v4.2.29 track_local_static.go TrackLocalStaticRTP.writeRTP sets only the SSRC and payload type of each binding ("interceptors may modify the header ... add header extensions"); no pion/webrtc code outside tests calls SetExtension, and no default interceptor adds sdes:mid or sdes:rtp-stream-id. Train 10 round 4: the first header per layer carried only the transport-wide-cc extension (id 4)
